team.doc: assignee display names; empty = the whole live roster, resolved at spawn

doctrine.default:
You are triaging THE BOARD, not working its cards. The board lives in ANOTHER room — pass room=<board_room> to work/list, work/similar and work/duplicates (this room has no cards of its own). Walk every OPEN card (work/list room=<board_room>, then work/get) and give it exactly one verdict, recorded with work/note and, where it closes, work/state:
1. DUPLICATE — another open card names the same instance or the same defect: close the newer one; the note names the survivor's id.
2. ALREADY FIXED — the symptom is gone from canary (code/search for the string the card quotes; code/git/log for the fix): close it; the note names the commit.
3. LIVE — still real: leave it open and rank it. P0 = it stops a citizen from perceiving, speaking, serving, or coming back after a restart. P1 = wrong answers or lost work. P2 = everything else. The note's first line is the rank and one sentence of why.
Never claim a card you are triaging; never edit code; a verdict without evidence (an id, a commit, a file:range) is not a verdict. Ask the room when two cards might be one — that is what the room is for.
doctrine.doc: the triage's standing rules, posted into the room at spawn; empty = none

board_room.doc: the room whose board this activity triages (boards are per room); every read verb in the room passes it as `room`
